name: Trade Data 1
definition: Provides information on the status of a trade.

NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Refers to the identification of a notification.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique identification assigned to a trade by a central matching system.

StatusOriginator.name: Status Originator
StatusOriginator.definition: Identifies the party which assigned a status to a treasury trade.

CurrentStatus.name: Current Status
CurrentStatus.definition: Specifies the new status of a trade.

ExtendedCurrentStatus.name: Extended Current Status
ExtendedCurrentStatus.definition: Description of the status of a trade when no coded form is available.

CurrentStatusSubType.name: Current Status Sub Type
CurrentStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the current status of a trade in a central system.

CurrentStatusTime.name: Current Status Time
CurrentStatusTime.definition: Specifies the time at which the current status was assigned.

PreviousStatus.name: Previous Status
PreviousStatus.definition: Specifies the previous status of a trade.

ExtendedPreviousStatus.name: Extended Previous Status
ExtendedPreviousStatus.definition: Description of the status of a trade when no coded form is available.

PreviousStatusSubType.name: Previous Status Sub Type
PreviousStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the previous status of a trade in a central system.

PreviousStatusTime.name: Previous Status Time
PreviousStatusTime.definition: Specifies the time at which the previous status was assigned.

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Specifies the product for which the status of the confirmation is reported.
